title: Chapter 202 Back
content:
Chapter 202 Back

"Haha, this kind of person is not suitable to enter the deserted city."

Lu Daosheng said with a smile.

In order to survive, the ancestor of Xuanzong did whatever he wanted.

If Lu Daosheng asked the ancestor of Xuanzong to join the Huangcheng on the condition of survival, he would definitely not refuse.

But in that case, I'm afraid the other party's heart will not be in the deserted city.

That was not what Lu Daosheng wanted.

Lu Daosheng is no longer what everyone wanted before.

Now, he will screen.

For example, Meng Tianyi and Lu Daosheng invited the other party before, but unfortunately he was rejected.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Yan Lingyun nodded slightly and said nothing more.

The two of them were very fast, and in a blink of an eye, they broke through the barrier of the fairy world again and returned to the wooden fairy world.

And at this time the spiritual realm.

The deserted city is particularly lively at this moment.

Countless powerful geniuses from the fairy world came to visit the deserted city.

After all, the strength of the Lord of the Huangcheng City is too terrifying. Until now, the scene of instantly killing a strong man in the late stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm shocked the world.

"Is this the wasteland city? It looks pretty good, but it doesn't seem to be very good."

As soon as a proud young man walked into the deserted city, he pointed at the deserted city while walking.

At this time, a figure blocked the young master.

"Dare you dare to slander the deserted city?"

I saw a man in a black suit and holding a long sword suddenly appeared in front of the young master, with a cold expression.

"Huh? You, who are you?"

Seeing that the manly aura in front of him was a little extraordinary, the young master did not dare to be careless and dodged his expression.

Obviously, although he said something bad about Huangcheng, he was still a little afraid inside.

"Hmph, the deserted city cannot be humiliated. You dare to say such words after entering my deserted city. You are simply seeking death."

laugh!

A sword light flashed, and the next moment, the young master's right arm was instantly cut off.

"ah!!"

Suddenly, the young master looked at the man in front of him with a pale face and looked at the man in front of him with horror.

"You, do you know who I am?"

However, the man holding the knife remained unchanged.

"In Huangcheng, no matter what your identity is, it will not work."

"Remember, let me hear you slandering Huangcheng again, it's not as simple as killing one of your arms."

After saying this, the man holding the knife headed towards the city gate.

When he was in place, the young master looked ugly.

"Damn guy, no matter who you are, I, Zhang Ziyuan, will take revenge!"

Zhang Ziyuan muttered to himself with hatred expression.

However, the next moment, a black light flashed.

Suddenly, Zhang Ziyuan's expression was dull.

His head slowly slid down from his neck.

The pedestrians on the street were a little shocked when they saw this scene.

Immortal King Realm.

The key is that he dared to commit crimes directly on the street. Who is this?

After a while, several guards hired from the deserted city came to clean up the scene.

As for Zhang Ziyuan being killed in the street, these guards did nothing, and they didn't even ask a question.

Above the gate of the deserted city.

"Brother Huang, has the city lord not come back yet?"

Awei walked slowly up toward this place.

Hearing this, Huang Shou, who was leaning against the wall with his sword in his arms, opened his eyes and looked at Awei.

"without."

At this time, a black light flashed, and An Xing's figure also appeared beside the two of them.

"You two are good."

An Xing smiled at the two of them.

"An Xing, why are you here too?"

When Awei saw An Xing, he immediately asked.

Hearing this, An Xing sighed and spread his hands and said, "I just came to the Immortal Realm not long ago. I have no power in the deserted city. I happened to be idle for a while, so I came to take a look."

Although Lu Daosheng brought Huang Shou'an Xing and others to the fairy world.

But most of the Huangweigen organizations and others in the deserted city stayed there.

Today, although there is still an immortal world in the deserted city, it is obviously very different from the original deserted city.

Of course, the gap does not refer to strength, but to management systems.

Now in the deserted city of the Immortal Realm, there are only some casual cultivators hired by Anfeng through a lot of financial resources to act as the city guards and escorts in the city.

The control power is not high, which is why the people in the deserted city have no rules and are all a little disorganized.

And An Xing and others forced everyone here some time ago through Lu Daosheng.

At first, Wan Feng was shocked when he felt An Xing and others.

A force of an unknown force suddenly appeared inside the deserted city without warning, no one would panic.

Fortunately, no misunderstanding occurred. Wan Feng soon learned that this was the first deserted city established by Lu Daosheng in the fairy world.

And these days, An Xing and Awei have been observing the layout inside the wasteland city.

It has to be said that compared with the city lord himself who built the Dihuang City, the momentum is really far behind.

But they dare not say anything in front of Wanfeng.

After all, although I have practiced hard in the Lu Daosheng Di Palm world for a long time, my strength has improved greatly.

But facing the current immortals roaming the earth's fairy world, Huang Shou and others' strength is not very high.

Now, Huang Shou's strength is at the peak of the Immortal King Realm, and this speed is considered very fast among the few people.

Most people such as An Xing Awei and Gu Chen are in the early stage of the Immortal King Realm.

At the same time, in the lord's mansion in the deserted city.

"Hey, Wanfeng, when will my parents come back?"

Lu Xue lay on the table and sighed with her head against her head.

On the side, Wanfeng stood respectfully beside Lu Xue, "Miss, the city lord and his men should be back soon."

Only after hearing this did Lu Xue stand up.

"I'm so busy just after arriving in the fairyland, alas."

Lu Xue sighed again.

Seeing this, Wanfeng blushed slightly.

Lu Daosheng and his men left as soon as they arrived in the fairyland, all because of her.

Suddenly, Wanfeng felt a little guilty.

If I had recovered my strength earlier, the city lord and my master wouldn't have to go to ask for justice for me.

When I saw Lu Xue for the first time, Wanfeng was stunned.

So similar, really so similar.

She was just like her master.

It's just that her face didn't have a bit more domineering than her master's, but was more gentle.

So when Lu Xue told her identity, Wanfeng didn't have a single doubt.

"Miss, how about I help you find them?"

At this time, Wanfeng hesitated.

Seeing Lu Xue like this, Wanfeng felt a little bit reluctant.

This is the precious daughter of her master, and even more so the precious daughter of the city lord. These two identities are enough for her to protect with her life.

Hearing Wanfeng's proposal, Lu Xue's face lit up.

"Really?"

Wanfeng nodded, "Really."

"Then can you take me with you?"

Lu Xue looked at Wanfeng with hopeful eyes.

Seeing this, Wanfeng was still very hesitant, but looking at Lu Xue's eyes, he couldn't say no.

"This,,, then, that's good."

"Wanfeng, you are so kind!"

Lu Xue was so excited that she went up and hugged Wanfeng.

Finding her parents is actually secondary. The most important thing is that she wants to go out and see what the fairyland is like.

Originally, she wanted to wait for her parents to come back and ask them, but now it seems that she can go out in advance.

Just when Lu Xue was happy, Xun Heng suddenly ran in.

"Miss, Lord Wan, Lord City Lord and the others are back!"
